summary: The calibration layer is computationally cheap and no reported cost blocks deployment, but the cost evidence is measured on the wrong configuration, under uncontrolled/mixed conditions, and described inaccurately: '0.437 ms per building-day' is neither a per-building latency nor a measurement of the recommended layer, and the memory/scalability claims for portfolio deployment (Sec. 6.3) count only the calibration store and are never tested beyond ~170 calibration buildings. A cost comparison across compared strategies is missing.

issues.title: Reported cost refers to a different configuration than recommended
issues.evidence: Timer in src/training/pipeline.py:318-321 wraps only absolute-score 'HSC' (kNN prior + stage matching; main_BDG2 hsc_K=25/25/25/10/25, kappa=96-168 in run_info.json). Abstract attaches 0.437 ms to the one-parameter layer with pseudo-count of one to two weeks (HSC-CQR simple: K=None, kappa=336 in all BDG2 seeds); 3.4%/0.6% come from full HSC-CQR. HSC-CQR, HSC-CQR simple and their LOBO tuning are never timed.
issues.action: Time the recommended HSC-CQR simple (and HSC-CQR) separately; report in abstract, Sec. 5.7, Table 8 with variant labels.
issues.experiment: Re-time calibration step for HSC-CQR simple and HSC-CQR on cached predictions.

issues.title: 'ms per building-day' is batch-amortised throughput measured under contention
issues.evidence: Table 8 caption: 'computing one building's radius for one day'. Code times one vectorised call over all targets x 56 stages divided by St.shape[0]*NH (pipeline.py:321). Own-score histogram construction cc_t=cb.cum_counts(St) (Python double loop) is outside the timer (~pipeline.py:245). Calibration ran as 4 concurrent workers with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 (scripts/calibration_pass.sh), caption says '4-core CPU'. Seed spread 0.175-0.639 ms (HSC update), 0.14-1.32 ms (LightGBM inference). No CPU model, repetitions or warm-up; means to three decimals.
issues.action: Describe as amortised batch cost or measure true single-building latency incl. score update; benchmark on idle machine with stated hardware, repetitions, median+IQR, fewer digits.
issues.experiment: Micro-benchmark: 100 repetitions of the daily update for 1 building and batches of 10^3/10^4.

issues.title: UCI training time inflated by known OpenMP stall
issues.evidence: main_UCI_s1 train_total 2254 s (LightGBM 1317 s, MLP 929 s) vs 102-126 s other seeds; CHANGELOG documents oversubscription stall; Table 8 mean 298 s makes UCI look 3x slower than BDG2. Median LightGBM ~47 s.
issues.action: Exclude/re-run stalled seed or report medians; note in caption.
issues.experiment: Retrain UCI seed-1 timing only on idle machine (optional).

issues.title: 'Few megabytes' memory claim ignores per-building state
issues.evidence: Sec. 6.3 'a few megabytes of memory', 'compatible with portfolio-scale deployment'. hsc_store_MB (pipeline.py:322) counts only calibration CDFs/descriptors. Target state self_cc shape (nt,56,4000) int16 (calibration.py:47) ~448 KB/building (~45 GB at 10^5). Mixture needs only one running 4000-bin histogram (16 KB) or <=1344 raw scores (~5 KB).
issues.action: Report per-building and portfolio memory; describe minimal sufficient state.

issues.title: kNN search and LOBO tuning scaling untested
issues.evidence: neighbours() builds dense nt x ncal x d tensor (calibration.py:~136); tune_hsc repeats for 5 K x 56 stages: O(|K| NH M^2 d). Only ~170 (BDG2) / ~63 (UCI) calibration buildings tested; kNN adds nothing (MACD 0.017 vs 0.018).
issues.action: Drop kNN from the recommended pipeline or report scaling with M.
issues.experiment: Scaling benchmark with resampled calibration buildings (M=170, 1k, 10k).

issues.title: No cost comparison across ranked strategies
issues.evidence: Table 8 HSC only. Total calibration per run 230-339 s on BDG2 vs 36.7 s quoted for 'one-off tuning'. QShrink-CQR close to HSC-CQR (BDG2 MACD 0.022 vs 0.018, IS 0.562 vs 0.564; UCI 0.016 vs 0.014) and needs only an own quantile and a scalar radius.
issues.action: Add tuning time, update time, state size for every calibration strategy.
issues.experiment: Instrument run_calibration for all methods; calibration only.

issues.title: Inference cost column incomplete
issues.evidence: t_pred_lgb times only the point model (pipeline.py:160-163), excluding the two quantile models, feature construction and descriptors. 0.437 ms is ~65% of quoted 0.668 ms inference.
issues.action: Report end-to-end daily latency per building; phrase comparison accurately.

issues.title: Grid approximation trade-off not justified
issues.evidence: 4000 asinh-spaced points, upward rounding, cap 500 s; linear argmax per quantile (_first_ge); exact sorted-score quantiles would be cheaper; no check of grid-induced coverage bias.
issues.action: Report grid vs exact quantile coverage/width difference on one seed, or justify grid size.
